conf.description: OpenShift kube-apiserver/openshift-apiserver audit, syslog-raw (RFC5424): un-frame the header, parse MSG as the audit.k8s.io/v1 Event, nest it under kubernetes.audit for the same downstream handling the json feed gets, map header fields to ECS, set _time from the event's own requestReceivedTimestamp per the catalog note that the header stamp is only collection/framing time.

conf.comment: OpenShift kube-apiserver audit via ClusterLogForwarder syslog output. Un-frame RFC5424, parse MSG as the audit Event, nest under kubernetes.audit so it feeds the same audit_logs handling the json feed uses. Header fields (facility/severity/appname/procid/msgid) are constants or duplicates of the payload per the catalog - kept only as provenance.

functions.description: record dataset, format, and parsing approach
strip the RFC5424 frame: PRI, TIMESTAMP, HOSTNAME, APP-NAME, PROCID, MSGID, MSG
batch the mapped/partial header fields to their ECS targets
decompose PRI into facility/severity, nest the audit Event, promote log_source, set _time from the event's own timestamp, tag event.dataset
Re-nest flat dotted keys (data-maps canonical step)
